# Demo WebdriverIO JavaScript for NHS Wales

> A friendly, step-by-step demo of WebdriverIO browser automation with
> JavaScript, structured as a real Mocha test suite (`describe`/`it`),
> testing three real user scenarios against the live production
> NHS Wales website (https://www.nhs.wales/).

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Install/run instructions, chromedriver
  troubleshooting, and what this demo tests.
- [spec/index.md](spec/index.md): Single source of truth for the exact
  three assertions and selectors checked against the live nhs.wales site.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Instructions for coding agents working in this
  repo.
- [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff): Citation metadata for this software.

## Code

- [test/specs/demo.js](test/specs/demo.js): The three real Mocha `it`
  test cases with their assertions.
- [wdio.conf.js](wdio.conf.js): WebdriverIO configuration, including the
  `baseUrl` for the live site.
